title: Weatherless Window
creative_premise: A locally generated atmosphere that responds to direction without retaining identity.

coverage: single-file runtime with no external network dependencies
no Mirror Cartographer, dashboard, payment, subscription, or signup vocabulary
reduced-motion, focus-visible, live-status, pressed-state, and safe-area safeguards

evidence_strength: committed source plus local deterministic tests
